problem.observed: Required shell newlines arrived as whitespace in two separate one-shot sessions. Hardening only the point that just failed left the same transport class elsewhere. Step 1 and Step 2.6 remained multiline, while a directly executable single-line Step 4 still would not prove full-payload receipt before --apply.
problem.design_conclusion: For long or production-critical programs, receive inert encoded data first, prove exact full bytes, then source. No decoded program byte executes before transport-integrity verification.

remediation_scope.principle: Two-action receive/verify/source envelope. Action A is inert base64 assignment plus receipt marker. Action B is a short frozen loader that validates exact decoded SHA-256, writes O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode-0600 tmpfs bytes, re-hashes, verifies file type/mode/owner, then sources exact bytes in the current audited shell and deletes the file on success.

payload_derivation.encoding: RFC4648 standard base64, no line wrapping, of exact decoded program bytes including one final LF
payload_derivation.assignment_integrity: Before delivery Core must deterministically derive BASE64 from the exact bound decoded bytes and match both base64_length and base64_sha256 below. Any mismatch => STOP_NO_DELIVERY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
payload_derivation.loader_template_exact:
PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH='__PATH__'; test ! -e "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' /dev/shm)"; { test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'; } || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; python -B -c 'import base64,hashlib,os,sys; p,s,h=sys.argv[1:]; b=base64.b64decode(s,validate=True); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h; fd=os.open(p,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600); f=os.fdopen(fd,"wb"); f.write(b); f.close(); assert hashlib.sha256(open(p,"rb").read()).hexdigest()==h' "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_B64" '__DECODED_SHA256__' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_INTEGRITY_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; test -f "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" && test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH")" = '600' && test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH")" = "$(command id -u)" || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; . "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH"; PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC=$?; command rm -f -- "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH"; unset PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_B64; test "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC" -eq 0 || exit "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC"; unset PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC
